scope: Read-only XKB actions for both mapped pointer devices and released paired-core-keyboard state/controls; shared client subscriptions, NoAction canonicalization and bounded dedicated input-monitor lifetime. No pointer motion/button packet or business click.

initial_results.finding: Actual integrated proof exhausted the previous input-monitor 1024-request lifetime. Kept ordinary Wire at1024/2048 and assigned dedicated InputWire8192 requests/8448 messages, with original cumulative bytes/event cap/timeouts. Added real request-boundary/no-extra-packet regressions; no sequence reset or test assertion relaxation.
Explicit int cast for the bounded protocol name-length field removes Unknown propagation; no type-ignore.

pointer_action_contract.prerequisites: Same existing native point, XTEST sources and full slave/master button maps. ButtonPlan retains both actual verified counts.
pointer_action_contract.xkb_environment: Actual core keyboard must match verified pointer-master pair. Existing state/control reader rejects latch/lock/group/modifier or unsupported MouseKeys-like controls. Environment read before and after both action replies.
pointer_action_contract.device_info: GetDeviceInfo ButtonActions only, all buttons. Exact device, supported/present feature, total/wanted/returned range, zero LED payload and no independent keyboard state. Name1..1024 and exact bounded counted-string/action payload.
pointer_action_contract.canonical_identity: All button types must be NoAction. Omitted leading/trailing records, absent vs allocated all-NoAction and unused record/alignment padding normalize alike. Device metadata, name, feature/feedback/type identity remain bound.
pointer_action_contract.observation: Publish both real device IDs before SelectEvents ExtensionDeviceNotify for each; keep keyboard original masks. Notification/failure/cancellation invalidates old proof; no own pointer exemption. Keyboard and pointer readers can prepare in either order without replacing subscriptions.
pointer_action_contract.snapshot: Double-read and verify before use bracketed by complete old window/point/source/map guards; old preparation cannot rebind after visible restoration.

correction_2026_11_18.original_cumulative_received_bytes_field: Base Wire cap only, incorrectly reported as effective InputWire cap in this historical record.
